displayAttacks.displayText: AngularQuín unleashes a swift explanation powered by notes, slides, and NotebookLM.
Launches a precise strike of typed code that leaves the rival without autocomplete.
RaMaven arrives at full speed with his Scirocco 1.4, running over the opponent standing in front of him.
He lifts a Spring Boot structure so heavy that it crushes any poorly built project.
BelgraNode appears from the shadows and steals the opposing agent's tokens without saying a word.
He executes a pirate deployment straight to production, with a light blue flag and zero rollback.
SantorMento throws a questionnaire with sharp questions that set the unsuspecting student on fire.
With his pair of horns, he summons a grade of 2 (Two) in the opponent's notebook without much justification.
HernullPointer chooses a random question and psychically exposes the opponent.
It concentrates all its power into a single instance that is impossible to counter.
